what: The appraisal result for a thing the person owns (spec/pages.md §6.11, spec/features/appraise.md): what it is, what similar ones sold for, what they would keep on each site, and the next step.

frame.who: Testing the water and clearing out, once per thing, often before they decide to sell at all; the flipper checks many in a row; a new person may arrive here before linking any site.
frame.came_to: Know what it is worth in a number they can trust, and whether it is worth selling.
frame.mistake_costs_most: A number with no source: the range is only ever from sold comparables, each site's row says when there are too few sales, and the sales are one tap away.
frame.ways_out: Keep it (just value it) saves the value and never asks to list it; a typed model number when the photo was not enough (ways-out §6.11); a site with too few sales shows no number instead of a guess.
frame.in_the_loop: Keep it only saves a value, so it acts and shows Kept with Undo; Sell this only starts the listing, and the price is set later on Plan where it waits for the person.

decisions.decision: The photo and name in one 72 row, then the range at 50, no page title
decisions.why: The number is the focal point (copy.md, one focal point); the thing is recognised by its photo (C3). A heading over it would be a second large thing saying what the nav already implies.

decisions.decision: The value is a range in whole dollars, widened outward, labelled "What similar ones sold for lately"
decisions.why: appraise: every number guarded and from sold comparables; copy.md: "Similar ones sold for $36 to $52 lately", never a sample size. Cents on an estimate claim a precision the sales do not have.

decisions.decision: Check the sales opens the sales the value goes by, one row per site with a tick the person can take off
decisions.why: Ben, 06:19: "you should be able to obviously investigate. Like human in the loop is very important" (product/words.md#2026-11-15-notes-on-the-first-gallery-today-must-explain-itself-you-is-a-dashboard-the-camera-frames-the-listing-photo). The person knows their thing better than a match does; a site whose sales are not the same thing is left out and the range follows.

decisions.decision: You get: one row per site, best first, logo, how long it takes there, and the keep range at the right edge
decisions.why: pages §6.11 "for an owner: what you'd keep per site"; money.md D9 via youKeep; the amount sits where every marketplace row puts it.

decisions.decision: A site with too few sales says so and shows no amount
decisions.why: appraise: "a route with no basis is hidden with its reason, never guessed".

decisions.decision: "Not linked" under a site only when the person has linked some
decisions.why: For someone with sites linked it explains why Sell this won't post there; for a new person every row would say it, which is noise (ways-out: Worth works with no site).

decisions.decision: Sell this (black) and Keep it (light fill) side by side after the keep rows
decisions.why: pages §6.11 actions; the decision comes after the facts that make it. Keep it only saves a value, so it acts and shows Kept with Undo; Sell this hands the price to Plan.

decisions.decision: Glance shows the range labelled "Rough guess", each site "Checking", and no next step
decisions.why: appraise step 2: the 2 s answer is labelled rough; nothing is decided on a rough number.

decisions.decision: Unsure: "Which one is it?", the guess dotted, a Model number blank, and I don't know
decisions.why: ways-out §6.11 typed model number; edge-cases §4: I don't know is an answer. Below the qualified-to-price gate there is no number (appraise).

decisions.decision: A price in mind is optional; one far from the sales (over 3x the top, under a third of the bottom) asks once with the range
decisions.why: edge-cases §3 and ways-out "Oops, $500, I meant $50". The question names the range and puts the person's own price on the button.

decisions.decision: A could-be-valuable mark replaces Sell this with Get it appraised
decisions.why: edge-cases §4: a hallmark, signature or maker's mark stops the quick path. No demo item carries such a mark yet, so this path is not rendered.

decisions.decision: Look deeper and the model number are plain rows at the end
decisions.why: Art. 7.9: what is not today's decision sits in ruled rows at the end of the page.

decisions.decision: Loading holds the range’s place in gray; failed and offline show no number
decisions.why: appraise: every number from sold comparables; a number the sales did not give is never shown, even an old guess.

decisions.decision: Empty, one and dense are skipped on Worth
decisions.why: Worth is always one thing on one page, so it has no list to be empty, single or crowded (Screen skip).

decisions.decision: With sales left out, the range is the lowest to the highest of the sales kept, and says "From the sales you kept"; a left-out site keeps nothing in You get
decisions.why: appraise: every number from sold comparables. A number the person set aside never feeds the value.

decisions.decision: Look deeper also sits at the end of the sales sheet
decisions.why: The agent's next step belongs where the person found the sales thin; it lands on Today when done.

decisions.decision: No link to each site's sold search yet
decisions.why: The demo has no sale URLs, and eBay's sold search went behind a login in July 2026 (research/price/ben/comps-sources-live.md). A link the person can't open is worse than none; it waits for real sale rows.
